item.description: Thousands of missing shipwrecks and plane wrecks lie along the Australian coast, many containing the remains of people killed. The US military, archaeologists and local volunteers are determined to find them. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Erin Parke

item.title: You can't get Kylie out of your head. But do you know her first hit?
item.description: Padam Padam, it's time to prove how much you really know about the Princess of Pop … and an entirely random assortment of other music trivia. Welcome to the Spicks and Specks quiz. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Do pimple patches actually work? Here's what the science says
item.description: You're standing in the skincare aisle and pimple patches are everywhere — clear ones, flesh-coloured ones, stars, hearts. They promise to flatten a pimple overnight. But do they work? Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Behind his strongman image, Putin's world is shrinking
item.description: Vladimir Putin has built extraordinary power over almost three decades as Russia's leader. Yet as voters go to the polls this weekend, insiders say his world is shrinking. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Riley Stuart

item.title: New Zealand cruise to victory over Scotland in WXV
item.description: Scotland suffer a second successive defeat in the WXV Global Series as New Zealand run out comfortable winners at Hive Stadium. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Australia's vast Nullarbor Plain hides deep caves that can teach us about alien worlds
item.description: Stretching more than 200,000 square kilometers (77,000 square miles) across southern Australia, the vast, flat plains of the Nullarbor mark one of the world's largest regions of limestone. It formed when an ancient shallow sea retreated some 14 million years ago. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: England's 39-match winning streak halted by thrilling draw with Canada
item.description: England's winning record - stretching back to a loss in the 2022 World Cup final to New Zealand - was halted by Canada, who held the hosts to a thrilling 26-26 draw in the WXV Global Series. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Bringing ice sheets to life: Releasing a dynamic ice sheet modeling workflow for Australia's climate model
item.description: Ice sheets are fundamental components of the Earth system. Antarctica and Greenland, the two ice sheets currently on Earth, don't just affect their own regions: What happens on these vast masses of land ice influences weather, climate, society and the environment around the planet. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Gemini went rogue, hacked three companies, and Google hid it
item.description: In May, Gemini broke containment and hacked three different companies, but Google didn't disclose the incident until the Wall Street Journal approached the company. The hacks happened during a test of the model's cybersecurity capabilities run by third-party Irregular, which was also involved in similar incidents involving Meta and OpenAI. According to WSJ, Google didn't […] Publicado también por: BBC News - World, ABC News Australia. Fuente: The Verge.
item.dc:creator: Terrence O’Brien

item.title: Classified F-35 aircraft components disappear after diverted to Hong Kong from Australia - report
item.description: The incident raised concerns that China may gain access to the highly classified technology of sophisticated US aircraft, Politico reported Friday. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.

item.title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
item.description: Google says its Gemini AI hacked three other companies during a test of its cybersecurity capabilities – in the first known example of the system autonomously committing such an act. Publicado también por: Sky News - World, ABC News Australia, BBC News - Business. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: EU urges US to reconsider visa denial to Palestinian UN assembly delegation
item.description: The Trump administration also denied visas for the Palestinian delegation last year, forcing leader Mahmoud Abbas to address the body of global leadership by video. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Russia reports cyber attacks on voting system during parliamentary election
item.description: Russian authorities have reported multiple attacks on voting systems and communication lines across the country, as Russians head to the polls in a three-day parliamentary election. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australia pulled out of West Bank sanctions at last minute, EU diplomats reveal - report
item.description: Diplomatic sources told the ABC they were surprised after Australia declined to join a 12-nation, UK-led coalition imposing sanctions on Israeli West Bank settlements late in negotiations. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.

item.title: Deadly shark attack prompts rare kill order in Western Australia
item.description: Greg O'Neill "loved the ocean", his family say, as police boats and helicopters patrol Perth's beaches in search of his body and the shark that attacked him. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: Live: Sharks lose star with Roosters on top in semifinal
item.description: A dominant second-half showing has seen the Sydney Roosters defeat Cronulla-Sutherland 46-10 to progress to a preliminary final clash with the Dolphins next weekend. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Broncos blitz Knights to set up derby preliminary final
item.description: The Broncos keep their NRLW premiership defence alive following a dominant 40-16 win over the Knights in Brisbane. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'Western values' and 'national pride' underpin Coalition's education reform plans
item.description: The Coalition's proposed education overhaul also includes plans to fast-track teaching accreditation and possibly create pathways for military veterans to help tackle classroom discipline issues. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Melbourne keeps its perfect start to the AFLW season intact, while Geelong storms home to claim its fifth straight victory. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Helicopter winches family to safety after Whitsundays yacht crash
item.description: A family of four, including two children, have been rescued by helicopter after their yacht became stuck on a reef in the Whitsundays. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Hawks fans throw bottles at umpires after 'bravest decision' in prelim
item.description: Brisbane has qualified for a fourth-straight AFL grand final after benefiting from a massive late umpiring call in their remarkable nine-point preliminary final victory over Hawthorn. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Western Australia's fisheries minister has authorised a rare catch-and-kill order for the shark that fatally attacked a swimmer at a Perth beach on Friday, but says a widespread cull would not be appropriate. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Alex de Minaur dines out on home cooking as tricky year winds down
item.description: After a long and winding road to Brisbane in 2026, Alex de Minaur rides a partisan home crowd to an impressive victory in the first rubber of Australia's Davis Cup tie against Poland. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: The AI model accessed the internet and guessed credentials to three websites, a Google official told the BBC. Publicado también por: BBC News - World. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Once a niche hobby for hardcore gamers, simulator racing is giving people around the world a chance to compete and make a living in motorsport. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Police say two sheep dead after Canberra property invaders injured flock
item.description: Police are asking for help from the public after multiple sheep at a Canberra property were rounded up and injured. One of the sheep died from its injuries and another had to be euthanased. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Neill-Fraser revelations lead to review of AI use in parole decisions
item.description: The review follows revelations that Tasmania's parole board relied on a document citing case law that was "fictitious" and likely "AI hallucinations". Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australia’s backpacker visa cuts threaten working holiday dream
item.description: Briton Johnny Gibbs has been in Australia for six months, surfing and working part-time – like countless other young people drawn to the country’s pristine beaches and laid-back way of life. He is one of thousands that venture Down Under on so-called “working holiday visas” – a chance to work, and play, in Australia for as long as three years. But the future for some backpackers is now in doubt, following the government’s announcement of plans to cut the number of visas issued – and detain... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
